midcycle_gap.read: The last twelve months' operating margin of 2.1% (CIQ EBIT) sits 7.7 points BELOW the 10-year median of 9.8% (EDGAR GAAP operating income) that R1 reverts to. R1 pairs that median with the median multiple from the same history, so an R1 value assumes a recovery to what the business was. If the decline is STRUCTURAL, that history overstates it; if it is a cyclical TROUGH, expecting recovery is right. On FY2025 the two sources differ by 12.5 points (GAAP a 14.1% loss vs CIQ a 1.6% loss): GAAP carries charges CIQ's EBIT excludes, and R1's median sits on the GAAP side — which pulls the median down toward the twelve months, so the difference narrows this gap rather than creating it: no reason to discount it, and if anything it understates it.
